summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of redesigned DiaGyn appointment booking page. All 5 steps of the booking flow work correctly with the new pastel 'Serene Care' theme. Found 1 minor bug in Weekly Schedule dialog displaying [object Object] instead of clinic names.

ui_bugs.issue: Clinic names display as '[object Object]' instead of actual clinic names
ui_bugs.root_cause: Line 1280 in DiaGyn.js uses doc.clinics?.join(', ') but clinics is an array of objects with 'name' property. Should be doc.clinics?.map(c => c.name).join(', ')

action_items: Fix Weekly Schedule dialog to properly display clinic names (line 1280 in DiaGyn.js)
critical_code_review_comments: DiaGyn.js is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Pastel color theme correctly implemented using design_guidelines.json colors
All 5 booking steps (Doctor, Clinic, Schedule, Verify, Confirm) work correctly
Calendar component properly disables past dates and Sundays
WebSocket connection for real-time slot updates working (Live Updates indicator visible)
Doctor profile cards highlight qualifications as required
Time slots show Morning/Evening color coding
Back button navigation works correctly through all steps

test_credentials.mock_otp: Dynamically generated - displayed on OTP screen

seed_data_creation: None required - uses existing doctor/clinic data
context_for_next_testing_agent: DiaGyn page redesign tested. All booking flow steps work. One bug found: Weekly Schedule dialog shows [object Object] for clinic names. Fix is simple - change doc.clinics?.join(', ') to doc.clinics?.map(c => c.name).join(', ') on line 1280.
